thread:
marco_support: ACME reports intermittent 502/504s and occasional 503s for hosted inference endpoints since ~09:20 PST. They see SDK retry loop and duplicate billing. Logs show HTTP/2 RST_STREAM from gateway. stacktrace attached.

acme_support: Seeing this on prod. Request id: req_7f3a9b2c. SDK shows backoff hitting 3 retries within 12s, then client-side 429s.

marco_support: Repro steps from ACME: curl to /v1/generate with stream=false, payload ~12k chars, concurrency 8. They can reproduce in eu-west-1. Paste curl below.

acme_support: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-xxx\" \\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n  -d '{\"model\":\"open-l9\",\"input\":\"<very large prompt>\"}'
```

julia_sre: Noted. From edge traces we see connection resets at the ingress LB: \"upstream reset: connection failure\" correlated with p95 CPU spikes on host pool r-45. Can you capture a full request/response and x-request-id?

marco_support: Attached trace id: trace:acme:78a9. Response header snippet: \"x-edge: gateway; x-upstream: reset\". Also saw TLS alert \"internal_error\" on a subset.

ingrid_prod: Quick mitigation: applied temporary routing to fallback pool (r-72) for acme org, can we keep for 30m? This reduced errors from ~8% -> ~1.2%.

devx_mike: Nice. For customers hitting SDK loops we should advise idempotency + exponential backoff (base 500ms, max 60s) and recommend SDK patch v1.2.3. Also need to confirm billing dedup window.

marco_support: Sending suggested comms to ACME: \"We're routing your traffic to a healthy capacity pool; please apply the latest SDK backoff patch (v1.2.3). We're investigating root cause and will credit affected requests.\" Draft ready, will send once infra confirms.

acme_support: Patch applied, still observed 1x 503 at 09:45. Not blocking but concerned about charges.

julia_sre: Action items: 1) collect tcpdump on r-45 host, 2) check kernel dmesg for OOM or panics, 3) validate TLS ciphers between edge and upstream, 4) run soak with client concurrency=10 for 30m. I'll own 1+2.

ingrid_prod: I'll extend fallback routing to 2h and notify infra on-call to watch r-45.

deploy-bot: deploy 2203-pool-fallback applied by ingrid_prod at 2234567920

julia_sre: Update @everyone 09:58 PST — correlated with a nightly autoscale job that terminated 4 instances in r-45 during a brief low-traffic window; timing overlapped with ACME burst causing transient connection churn. Investigating autoscaler.

marco_support: Communicated update to ACME: \"We identified an autoscale timing overlap causing transient connection resets. We've adjusted scaling window and routed your traffic. We'll credit affected requests; details via billing.\" They asked for ETA on credits.

devx_mike: Billing team — can we scope impacted request IDs (acme provided) and issue pro-rated credits? acme_support provided account id.

acme_support: Account id: acme_9001. Please confirm ETA.

marco_support: Billing triage pinged. ETA ~24-48h for credits; will follow up in this thread.

julia_sre: Root cause hypothesis: autoscaler terminated warm hosts prematurely while active connections existed -> upstream RSTs. Fix: increase scale-down grace period and mark hosts draining before kill. I'll open PR.

ingrid_prod: PR #1327 submitted to infra autoscaler: increase drain period to 120s and add pre-drain. Rolling deploy planned 02:00 UTC. No further customer impact observed after routing.

marco_support: Closing loop with ACME now. Will re-open if spikes reoccur.

acme_support: Thanks all :heart:
